top_trade_cards.name: US 2s30s Bull Steepener
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Weak labor data reprices the front end while fiscal borrowing, energy and term-premium risks keep the long end sticky.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: Uniform duration-rally framing ignores different front-end and long-end risk functions.
top_trade_cards.why_now: 2s30s near 100bp; US July CPI on Aug12 is next major validation.
top_trade_cards.expression: 3M2Y receiver swaption plus 3M30Y payer swaption, curve-DV01 matched; IRS/futures only as fallback.
top_trade_cards.entry: After global reopen if 2s30s remains 95-100bp, 2Y<=4.20% and 30Y>=5.15%; start one-third.
top_trade_cards.add: Add after CPI if front end rallies further while 30Y stays sticky.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: 2s30s<85bp, recessionary long-end rally dominates, or sharp hawkish front-end repricing; 2Y>4.30% warning.
alternative_expressions_rejected: 2s10s is less pure exposure to sticky long-end risk
large naked futures curve has more gap risk

top_trade_cards.name: Gold 3-6M Call Spread
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Gold has lower-real-yield/USD beta plus fiscal/geopolitical tail convexity.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: Pure real-yield models can underprice geopolitical/fiscal right-tail value while naked upside is inefficient after a strong week.
top_trade_cards.expression: Long 30-35 delta call, short 10-15 delta call, 3-6M; strikes/premium not fabricated without live chain.
top_trade_cards.entry: 1.5%-2.5% pullback around 4238-4282 with DXY<=100 and 10Y real<=2.50%, or confirmed breakout without USD/real-yield reversal.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: DXY>101, 10Y real>2.55%, and gold<4200 in combination.
alternative_expressions_rejected: gold plus 30Y put as primary trade

top_trade_cards.name: Brent 1-2M Upside Call Spread / Call Fly
top_trade_cards.core_logic: Full unobstructed Hormuz reopening is not achieved, but diplomatic progress raises the opposite downside tail.
top_trade_cards.mispricing: The attractive exposure is binary shipping right-tail convexity, not certainty that spot oil must rise.
top_trade_cards.expression: Buy 25-35 delta call / sell 10-15 delta call; use call fly if upside IV is extreme after reopen.
top_trade_cards.entry: After ICE reopen only; start one-third if gap is manageable and there is no executable unconditional commercial reopening. Do not chase a 4%-5%+ gap.
top_trade_cards.invalidation: Executable no-impediment reopening plus actual shipowner/insurance normalization.
alternative_expressions_rejected: pre-emptive bearish put spread before reopening is executable
